stories.title: LiteLLM release pipeline hacked to distribute info-stealer malware
stories.summary: Hackers compromised the LiteLLM project's PyPI package and published malicious Docker images with a payload that steals credentials, secrets, and environment variables.

stories.title: At the fourth attempt, Medvedev defends a title for the first time, coming from a set down to beat Basilashvili in Almaty
stories.summary: Daniil Medvedev (No. 1) came from a set down to beat qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7 (6), 6-1, 6-3 in Almaty and defend a title for the first time in his career. His 25th title, and fourth of the season, lifts him to fifth in the Race to Turin.

entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
